parsed.rationale: Both `StringCache` (in `_Plant_StringCache.swift`) and `IntCache` (in `_Plant_IntCache.swift`) within the `Caching` package share an identical structural shape — `capacity:Int`, `hitCount:UInt64`, `lastAccess:Date?`, and `storage:[K: CacheEntry]` — differing only in the key type of `storage` (`String` vs `Int`). This is the canonical PAT signal: a single varying slot whose type is the natural associated type. Introducing a `CacheProtocol` with `associatedtype Key: Hashable` and a `storage: [Key: CacheEntry]` requirement (plus `capacity`, `hitCount`, `lastAccess`) would unify both types under one abstraction, allowing generic algorithms over any cache keyed by a `Hashable` type. Neither record carries any restraint marker (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so no restraint override is needed.
